title: CloseBoundaryRisk
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch — close-boundary risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0, same convention as Slices 1-5. discipline='planning' is a presentation-only grouping tag, not a Planning Intelligence dependency — see close-boundary-risk.js's own comment. Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain.

CloseBoundaryInput.description: The raw p.facts.closeBoundary value. Inequality against the single literal 'No' — every other value ('Yes', 'Not sure', empty string, null, undefined, or an unrecognised value) must produce the risk.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when closeBoundary === 'No'.

text.const: Nearby boundaries/buildings may affect design, fire strategy, access or approvals.
